name: Hurkyl
description: Of the College of Lat-Nam, first member.

description_citations.text: "Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl found the college to codify magic, understand Thran artifacts and stop the brothers.
timeline.quote: The College of Lat-Nam was founded by Drafna and Hurkyl

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl go to Terisia City and create the Union of the Third Path with the Archimandrite and the Brotherhood of Gix.
timeline.quote: they created the Union of the Third Path

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon receives the Golgothian Sylex and Coral Helm from the Yumok and learns magic from Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: He also started learning magic from Hurkyl , eventually learning to tap into the red mana of his mountain home.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl unsummons a group of artificial killing machines during the battle.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl used a magical spell to unsummon a group of artificial killing machines

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kayla leads the refugees west in 79 AR as Penregon falls.
timeline.quote: with the Fall of Penregon happening that autumn

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran travels from Penregon to Terisia City and meets the scholars at the Ivory Tower.
timeline.quote: She arrived at the Ivory Tower and there met Feldon

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl study the machines on Lat-Nam, keeping many discoveries secret until after their deaths.
timeline.quote: Although their separatist views kept many of their discoveries secret until after their death

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl's Recall, a spell attributed to Drafna, is revealed to be the work of his wife Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: was actually the work of his wife Hurkyl

citation.text: Hurkyl's Recall (Revised Edition, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl's Recall, attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife and former student Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: was actually the work of his wife and former student, Hurkyl.

citation.text: Hurkyl's Recall (Fourth Edition, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl did the work that was credited to Drafna.
timeline.quote: This spell, like many attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife and former student, Hurkyl.

citation.text: Hurkyl's Recall (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash with only seconds to escape.
timeline.quote: With just a few seconds to escape, Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

citation.text: Rescue (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invites the first members of the Third Path.
timeline.quote: As its first members, the Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invited the Abbot from the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kayla studies Hurkyl's writings and learns to control her magic through a stone from Kroog.
timeline.quote: Kayla's new nightly practice followed the precepts of Hurkyl's meditative techniques as laid out in the book.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl's followers show Mishra's army the secrets of the Third Path.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl's followers graciously showed them.

citation.text: Scatter Ray (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gixians betray the Third Path; Hurkyl dies defending Terisia City and Loran flees with the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl dies defending the city.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl arrive in Terisia City from the College of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: both Hurkyl and Drafna were fully shaved bald

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna is present for the Fall of Terisia City, where Hurkyl dies unsummoning three dragon engines.
timeline.quote: his wife Hurkyl died after unsummoning three dragon engines

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies as a defender after casting the spell later named Hurkyl's Recall.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisia City falls after Mishra's siege; Hurkyl is killed.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl was among those who were killed

citation.work: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam
citation.text: "Fall of the College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies casting a spell to disappear Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Hajar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Invited to Terisia City, Hurkyl joins others to establish the Union of the Third Path, seeking neutrality in the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl joined her husband, Feldon , Chayum-Icha , Kathwar , and others to attend meetings to establish the Union of the Third Path .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl teaches meditation techniques to pupils including the Archimandrite.
timeline.quote: She taught her techniques to an increasingly growing crowd of pupils, including the Archimandrite .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra's forces breach Terisia City; Hurkyl vaporizes three dragon engines, then is killed by spearmen.
timeline.quote: She was killed by invading spearmen right afterwards.

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies defending the city, casting a spell that makes three dragon engines vanish.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon, Chayum-Icha, Kathwar and others meet with the Archimandrite to establish the Third Path as a neutral alliance.
timeline.quote: to establish the Third Path , also known as the "Union".

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Archimandrite shows aptitude at Hurkyl's meditative technique and names the energies "mana".
timeline.quote: The Archimandrite showed great aptitude at this

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
